title: POST /v1/telemetry with per-record validation

user_story.i_want: to POST a batch of records and learn which were accepted or rejected and why
user_story.so_that: one bad record doesn't fail my whole batch

description: `POST /v1/telemetry` accepts `application/json` (an array of up to 500 envelopes) or `application/x-ndjson`. Each record is deserialized and validated on its own (STR-105). A well-formed batch always gets 200 with `{accepted, rejected:[{index, event_id?, errors[]}]}`. A malformed body, a non-array, or more than 500 records gets 400. Accepted records become `IngestedRecord` (tenant_id `default` until STR-203, received_at = now) and go to a `RecordSink` trait. Use an in-memory sink for now; the Firehose client replaces it in STR-206. All errors use one JSON shape `{error:{code,message}}` via a custom error type that implements IntoResponse.

acceptance_criteria.then: accepted = 3 and the sink received 3 records with received_at set

acceptance_criteria.given: a batch where index 1 has no source_id
acceptance_criteria.then: accepted = 2 and rejected contains index 1 with the reason

acceptance_criteria.given: an NDJSON body with blank lines and one malformed line
acceptance_criteria.then: blank lines are skipped and the malformed line is rejected with its line index
they use a fake RecordSink and need no network

rust_concepts: async fn in traits and why it is not dyn-compatible (use a boxed future or the async-trait crate)
